user.title: MAC Registry
user.description: Builds a table linking MAC, IP and hostname to your Home Assistant devices and entities. No network scan, nothing is renamed or removed; devices are only changed if you turn on writing accepted links to the device.

data.write_connections: Write accepted links to the device

data_description.scan_interval: The table is also refreshed on registry and router tracker changes.
data_description.router_integrations: Leave empty to use every device tracker whose source is a router.
data_description.ignore_random: Locally administered MACs (second digit 2, 6, A or E). When kept they are flagged and never raise a repair.
data_description.use_dhcp: Reads the cache Home Assistant already keeps. Disabled automatically if it is not available.
data_description.write_connections: Off by default. When a link to a device is accepted, the MAC is added to that device in the device registry, if it does not declare it yet. Every MAC added is recorded and only those are removed again: by removing the link, with the Revert written MACs action, or when MAC Registry is removed.

add_override.title: Add a manual link
add_override.description: A manual link always wins over automatic matching. A label alone removes the MAC from the orphan list.

error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address.
error.override_empty: Choose a device or enter a label.

abort.not_loaded: MAC Registry must be loaded to edit manual links.

unseen_devices.name: Devices never seen by the router

lookup.name: Look up
lookup.description: Finds the device behind a MAC, an IP, a hostname or a raw log line.

query.name: Query
query.description: MAC, IP, hostname or a log line copied as is.

export.name: Export
export.description: Returns the whole table and can write it as CSV or Markdown in the configuration folder.

path.name: File
path.description: Optional, relative to the configuration folder, ending in .csv or .md (for example mac_registry.md).

format.name: Format
format.description: Optional, deduced from the file extension.

link.name: Link
link.description: Links a MAC to a Home Assistant device, or gives it a free label. Stored in MAC Registry; the device itself is only changed when writing to the device is on.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to link the MAC to.

label.name: Label
label.description: Free label for a MAC with no Home Assistant device (phone, computer...).

write_to_registry.name: Write to the device
write_to_registry.description: Also add the MAC to the device in the device registry, recorded so it can be removed again. Defaults to the option.

unlink.name: Unlink
unlink.description: Removes the manual link of a MAC.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC whose manual link is removed.

revert_written.name: Revert written MACs
revert_written.description: Removes from their devices every MAC MAC Registry added. The links themselves are kept.

data_description.link: The MAC is linked to the device in MAC Registry, and added to the device itself when writing to the device is on in the options.
data_description.known: A label removes the MAC from this list. Proposals accepted above win over this list.
